setup.description: Configure an Angular application to consume @rn-forge/ng and @rn-forge/ng-bootstrap.

add-bootstrap-table.description: Add the Bootstrap Table dependencies to an Angular application and optionally scaffold an example component.

configure-theme.description: Import the rn-forge Bootstrap theme into an Angular application's SCSS stylesheet.

scaffold-component.description: Scaffold a standalone Angular component, page, table or form in an application or library.

create-library.description: Create a publishable Angular library with the release, coverage, Storybook and Compodoc settings applied.
